desc.zh: 从连锁消除推导完整状态与记忆化搜索。
desc.en: Derive complete search states from chain reactions.

complexity: O(5SL³) time; O(S(L+h)+hL) space, where L=n+h and S is the exponential number of visited states

concepts.name: Zuma stable board and remaining hand
concepts.description: Normalize every chain reaction before caching the complete board and hand state.

concepts.name: Exact memoized insertion search
concepts.description: Enumerate all legal successor states, including setup moves, and reuse identical subproblems.
